companies.name: ブラックストーン

relations.text: 空調事業の過半を、ブラックストーンが運用するファンドに売却した
relations.text_en: Emerson sold a majority stake in its Climate Technologies business to funds managed by Blackstone

source.label: Emerson 10-K(2025年9月30日期)
source.quote: On May 31, 2023, the Company completed the sale of a majority stake in its Climate Technologies business (which constitutes the former Climate Technologies segment, excluding Therm-O-Disc which was divested earlier in 2022) to private equity funds managed by Blackstone in a $ 14.0 billion transaction.

relations.text: ブラックストーンとの新しい独立合弁に、40%の持分を残した
relations.text_en: Emerson retained a 40 percent stake in the new standalone joint venture with Blackstone

source.label: Emerson 10-K(2025年9月30日期)
source.quote: Emerson received upfront, pre-tax cash proceeds of approximately $9.7 billion and a note receivable with a face value of $2.25 billion, while retaining a 40 percent non-controlling common equity interest in a new standalone joint venture between Emerson and Blackstone.

relations.text: その持分は2024年8月にブラックストーン系ファンドへ売却済みである
relations.text_en: The stake was sold to Blackstone-managed funds in August 2024

source.label: Emerson 10-K(2025年9月30日期)
source.quote: Subsequently, in August 2024, Emerson sold its 40 percent non-controlling common equity interest in Copeland to private equity funds managed by Blackstone for $1.5 billion and sold the note receivable to Copeland for $1.9 billion.

relations.text: InSinkErator事業をワールプールに売却した
relations.text_en: Emerson divested its InSinkErator business to Whirlpool

source.label: Emerson 10-K(2025年9月30日期)
source.quote: On October 31, 2022, the Company completed the divestiture of its InSinkErator business, which manufactures food waste disposers, to Whirlpool Corporation for $3.0 billion.
